claude.sample_unit: patient questions on kidney cancer, each answered by 3 chatbots and rated by 4 urologists

links.outcome: Readability grade level of LLM-generated kidney cancer patient education responses versus recommended sixth-grade level
links.effect: Default LLM outputs exceeded sixth-grade level: ChatGPT-4.0 11.03 ± 1.76, Perplexity 12.66 ± 1.83, Gemini 10.83 ± 2.31; AUA PEM 9.84, EAU 11.88.
links.quote: Our analysis revealed overall higher than recommended readability scores for the responses generated by LLMs (ChatGPT 11.03 ± 1.76, Perplexity 12.66 ± 1.83, and Gemini AI 10.83 ± 2.31).

links.outcome: Reading level of LLM and official patient materials relative to recommended sixth-grade level
links.effect: All examined texts, official PEMs and LLM outputs, remained above the recommended literacy threshold; AUA most readable at 9.84 ± 1.2.
links.quote: Nevertheless, it is crucial to acknowledge that the readability levels of all examined texts remain elevated above the recommended literacy threshold for the general population.

links.outcome: Accuracy and guideline adherence of LLM kidney cancer answers rated by urologists on 5-point scale
links.effect: Overall high accuracy (ChatGPT 1.5, Gemini 1.9, Perplexity 2.2) with minor omissions; treatment least accurate (Perplexity 3.1); Gemini gave an answer not adhering to guidelines.
links.quote: Gemini AI, for example, provided answers that did not fully adhere to official guidelines, such as stating “A biopsy is the only definitive way to diagnose kidney cancer.”

unlisted_practices: Prompting chatbots to simplify outputs to a sixth-grade reading level to improve readability

links.outcome: readability grade of LLM education outputs
links.effect: LLM readability exceeded sixth-grade: ChatGPT 11.03 ± 1.76, Perplexity 12.66 ± 1.83, Gemini AI 10.83 ± 2.31.
links.quote: Our analysis revealed overall higher than recommended readability scores for the responses generated by LLMs (ChatGPT 11.03 ± 1.76, Perplexity 12.66 ± 1.83, and Gemini AI 10.83 ± 2.31).

links.outcome: accuracy of kidney cancer treatment outputs
links.effect: Treatment accuracy scores were Perplexity AI 3.1, ChatGPT-4.0/Gemini AI 2.0, on a 1-5 scale; 1=accurate/complete, 5=inaccurate.
links.quote: In the Treatment category, Perplexity AI achieved an accuracy score of 3.1, while both ChatGPT-4.0 and Gemini AI scored 2.0.

links.outcome: readability of AI-generated kidney cancer patient education materials
links.effect: mean readability scores were 11.03 ± 1.76 for ChatGPT-4.0, 12.66 ± 1.83 for Perplexity AI, and 10.83 ± 2.31 for Gemini AI, all exceeding the recommended sixth-grade reading level
links.quote: Our analysis revealed overall higher than recommended readability scores for the responses generated by LLMs (ChatGPT 11.03 ± 1.76, Perplexity 12.66 ± 1.83, and Gemini AI 10.83 ± 2.31).
